[EN] I feel for the refugees, but if we don't get back into the forest, we'll all be refugees before long.
[ES] Me compadezco de los refugiados, pero si no regresamos al bosque, todos seremos refugiados muy pronto.

[EN] Thank you. I'll make the medicine right away.
[ES] Gracias. Prepararé la medicina de inmediato.

[EN] I hope this will help them get better.
[ES] Espero que esto les ayude a mejorar.
